finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 section** into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 127 PRs, 17 real items.

Three break users. Expired tokens return `401`, not `403`. The v1 export route is gone. Internal error types stopped being re-exported. One feature: webhook retries with backoff. Two fixes people will feel: request bodies left the logs, and the latency histogram units changed, so dashboards shift.

I left out 4 perf commits. No user could tell without a benchmark.

Next: check the 401 and the histogram units are safe to ship unannounced.
